benchmark.description_note: vLLM benchmark_serving.py (not Artemis LLM Bench). 1 run × 100 prompts per model. 512in/512out tokens, max-concurrency 32, TP=2, GCP c4-highcpu-96. Intel Xeon 8581C Emerald Rapids, 96 vCPUs, ~180 GB RAM, AMX-bf16 + AMX-int8 + AVX-512. Baseline: vLLM v0.19.2rc0 stock CPU. Optimised: same + AMX dequant kernel (int4→bf16 tile fuse) + torch.topk sampler (O(V log k) vs O(V log V)).
